{{Top|leg}}
An '''advanced computer tool''' was an upgraded version of the retractable [[Computer probe/Legends|computer probe]]. This device was used to gain access to the higher programming functions of any [[computer terminal]] and [[computer networks]], though, [[interface adapters]] made it more effective.

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Droid/Legends|Droids]] must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
